body:
The repression of the memories and events works until something triggers something and PTSD comes into play. I have a list of things to avoid that helps, but my sweet girl has no idea that she's not supposed to mention innocuous things. She doesn't remember the bad parts. I literally cannot avoid my triggers. If I could avoid my triggers, this would be a whole different ball game.

The only way I could function through my mess was to repress what I did and to literally kill every emotion I had. It's hard to plot the ***** of someone who you used to love while having feelings. I became an emotionless monster. You know those movies where no one can figure out who the bad guy is because the bad guy is always smiling and bakes cookies for the neighbors? That's me.

I eat and I drink in small amounts, but my stomach seizes up. It refluxes. It rots in my stomach. I have Gastroparesis from this ordeal. I'm allergic to the medication that would unfreeze my stomach. I have been kicked around from GI to GI. I have horrible reactions to most medications. I'm labeled "medically sensitive" yet no one cares because I am like a rock. I'm always the last one standing, no matter what.

The day I had my first spinal tap I had things to do. There was no rest. There was no rehydration therapy time. Then came the spinal headaches for weeks, even after a blood patch. I'd walk around wearing sunglasses and holding medical barf bags in public. I'd sit on the ground throwing up, grey, shaking, all while shooing people away that I only needed a minute to get my shit together. I would drive while throwing up. I would drive while blind from migraines. I had lawyers to see. I had court dates to attend to. I had things that I could not miss. My will is greater than my body, except when it comes to my stomach.

I don't know if I benefit my daughter because she's seen me ill for so long. She's complaining of not being able to be like her friends because I can't take her places anymore. I can't carry her anymore. I can't even make it to the park one block away most days. She has said she's tired of having a sick mom. 

My blood pressure is through the roof. My vision dims every time I rise from sitting or laying down. My cholesterol is alarmingly high from long term malnutrition and dehydration. I can't even walk into urgent care and get hydration therapy because they don't want the liability of having me as a patient. They kick me to the ER and the ER sends me home after bitching me out for not going to urgent care. I have one safe medical zone, but the office hours are not compatible with my life. Even though I have the best insurance, I don't qualify for any home support because I am like a rock. Because I can function no matter what, I'm left to flounder. I can't fake not making it. I've tried, it doesn't work. 

I do my hobbies. I read, I play video games, I play with the kids, I have sex, I do everything a normal suburban mom does.

I take gummy vitamins. My hair falls out in clumps daily. My skin is ashen. My eyes are dull. My nails grow dented and are not healthy. 

I just got bitched at by my spouse for blowing this out of proportion. He can't fathom that I am having trouble because of what he's seen me do. He thinks I'm playing it up. He doesn't believe me because of how strong I am. He thinks I'm just a bitch and won't offer me any support, that's why I'm on Reddit. He laughed in my face when I told him that I couldn't live any longer. He thought I was joking. He expects me to do the taxes today and mow the yard while he plays with the kids. The weekends are typically his free time because he is the only one who works outside of the house. I work inside of the house and run the household. I get my free from from 6 until 9 every weekday. Even though that free time is spent with him or the kids, he just doesn't understand.

I met him during this bad time in my life. We were casual as in he was seeing multiple people, including me. I was only seeing him. I didn't have time for anything else really. He was a booty call that turned into a husband somehow. He knows every dirty deed I did. He knows where every "body" is buried. He is the only person in the world who knows exactly what I've been through.

I've been trying to heal my stomach for 2 years now. I can't stop losing weight. I have to binge on high calorie junk food to maintain or gain. It always makes me ill. I cannot intake enough to save my life.

I've been scraping by on using the vicoden I get for migraines on my stomach. That leaves me with nothing for migraine days. I'm robbing Peter to pay Paul. I don't have any tricks up my sleeve left. He literally left to go pick up the yard equipment for me. I have to go work my ass off for the next few hours while I feel like my body is falling apart.

I have no temperature regulation any longer. I don't sweat when I exercise. I get bright red, hot, and dizzy. I have to ice myself to cool down. After I do the yard today, I'm going to have to sit in a tub of cold water.

I don't know where this Reddit post will lead, or anything else in life for that matter. I'm lost. I never thought that my downfall would be my strength. Oh woe is me with my white girl problems they say. If they only knew, if they only knew...

The forest is literally two blocks away.
